theme: Ngân sách & cắt giảm chi phí

vocab.example: The board started a cost cutting plan for the next two quarters.
vocab.example_vi: Ban lãnh đạo đã khởi động kế hoạch cắt giảm chi phí cho hai quý tới.

vocab.example: Our office overhead went up after we rented the second floor.
vocab.example_vi: Chi phí vận hành văn phòng của chúng ta tăng lên sau khi thuê thêm tầng hai.

vocab.example: Each department now has a budget cap for software tools.
vocab.example_vi: Mỗi phòng ban hiện có một mức trần ngân sách cho các công cụ phần mềm.

vocab.example: We need to trim the travel budget by fifteen percent this year.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta cần cắt bớt ngân sách công tác mười lăm phần trăm trong năm nay.

vocab.example: Let's renegotiate the cleaning service price before we renew it.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy đàm phán lại giá dịch vụ vệ sinh trước khi chúng ta gia hạn.

vocab.meaning_vi: hợp đồng với nhà cung cấp
vocab.example: I reviewed every vendor contract to find fees we no longer need.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đã rà soát từng hợp đồng nhà cung cấp để tìm các khoản phí không còn cần thiết.

vocab.example: We will cut back on paid tools that only a few people use.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta sẽ giảm bớt các công cụ trả phí mà chỉ vài người sử dụng.

vocab.example: If we streamline the approval process, we save both time and money.
vocab.example_vi: Nếu chúng ta tinh gọn quy trình phê duyệt, chúng ta tiết kiệm cả thời gian và tiền bạc.

listening.title: A cost review meeting with the accounting team

lines.speaker: Nam (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Thanks for joining. The board asked us to prepare a cost cutting plan this week.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: I expected that. Our overhead is about eight percent higher than last year.

lines.speaker: Nam (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Where does the extra money go? Rent, software tools, or business travel?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Mostly software tools and travel. Both of them grew very fast in June.

lines.speaker: Nam (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Then let's trim the travel budget first, maybe by fifteen percent.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Agreed. I can also renegotiate two service prices before the end of the year.

lines.speaker: Nam (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Good. Please check every vendor contract for fees we no longer need.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Should we cut back on the design tools as well? Only three people use them.

lines.speaker: Nam (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Yes, and we will set a budget cap for each department from October.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: If we also streamline the approval process, the team will spend less time on paperwork.

questions.q: How much higher is the overhead than last year?
Which budget will they trim first?
When will the budget cap for each department start?

shadowing: We need to trim the travel budget by about fifteen percent this year.
Our overhead is eight percent higher than the same period last year.
Let's renegotiate the service price before we renew it in November.
Each department will have a budget cap starting from the fourth quarter.
If we streamline the approval process, we can save time and money.
